summary:
Reviewed 36ad963, the one implementation commit of w1; it matches the implementer's result. No change under features/, no test removed or weakened, no allowance claimed.
Names now resolve across initiatives (own initiative first), for: is rewritten, a name several other initiatives hold is refused, and the upgrade runs the move check. Probes confirmed each.
Minor observations: the move check has no unit test (the plan promised one); the refusal says 'reference' rather than the field and repeats lines; the widened token pattern would rewrite e.g. 'for: migration-tools#r26' if a work-item had that name (no current input does). Minor drop: a redundant duplicate-destination loop.
Cannot verify: migrate upgrade on a clone of this repository leaving model check clean (not runnable here).
The tools size check printed nothing. vulture is clean. ruff reports only style warnings that match the files' existing style.
